originStory.title: Why I Built This
originStory.subtitle: From typing pain to voice-first productivity
originStory.story: I type fast. Really fast. But it wasn't enough. Working with AI daily, I realized I was the bottleneck. AI works brilliantly when given the right context, and providing that context by typing was agonizingly slow. I'd have a complete thought, know exactly what I wanted to say, and watch it leak away as my fingers hunted for keys. Worse, after years of heavy keyboard use, my hands started hurting. At **40+**, the physical toll of all-day typing became impossible to ignore. I tried every voice-to-text tool out there: cloud services at **$20/month** that sent my voice to someone else's servers, browser extensions that only worked in Chrome, mobile apps that didn't talk to my computer. They all had the same problems: no privacy, subscription fees, usage limits, limited app support. I wanted something different. Something that respects privacy. Something I could **own, not rent**. Something that works everywhere. So I decided to build it myself. I learned `Rust` and `Tauri`, built an MVP, then discovered an open source project called Handy that was further along. I forked it and made it my own. I revamped the UI and UX, added features, built Linux support, and created a roadmap focused on Knowledge Management and AI integration. Knowii Voice AI is what I wanted to exist in the world.
originStory.inspirationPoint: The moment I realized I could speak a detailed AI prompt in **30 seconds** that would have taken **5 minutes** to type, and get dramatically better results, I knew this tool had to exist.
